name: deploy-twdiw-vp-verifier-lite
title_zh: 台湾数字身份证验证器，部署到 Cloudflare
tagline_zh: 已有 TWIDW 凭证验证服务？升级或迁移时最怕私钥丢失。这个 Skill 帮你把验证器部署到 Workers。
tagline_en: Upgrading or migrating your TWIDW verifier? This Skill deploys it to Workers with custom domain & API.
desc_en: Deploy or embed mashbean/twdiw-vp-verifier-lite as a Cloudflare Workers OIDC4VP verifier for Taiwan Digital Identity Wallet credentials. Use when configuring a new verifier, adding a custom domain or verification profile, integrating its API into an existing service, or updating a deployment without losing its did:key.
why_zh: 机制上，它把部署脚本和 did:key 持久化绑定，每次更新都先备份密钥再动配置。
why_en: Mechanically, it ties deployment to did:key persistence—backing up keys before any config change, preventing identity loss.
limit_zh: 仅适用于 mashbean/twdiw-vp-verifier-lite 仓库。
limit_en: Only for mashbean/twdiw-vp-verifier-lite repo; requires Cloudflare account & paid Workers plan for custom domains. Does not handle credential.
title_en: Deploy TWIDW OIDC4VP verifier on Cloudflare Workers, keep.
